interface.longDescription:
Currents gives AI agents the test results your CI records, from Playwright, Vitest, Jest and more.

Self-healing tests
• Ask why a run failed and get the errors, stack traces, screenshots and traces behind it
• Step through a run's Playwright trace, action by action, to see what the page did
• Find the root cause and fix the test, flaky ones included
• Compare a pull request's runs with main to see what the change broke

Proof of work for any change
• Before-and-after screenshots, videos, Playwright traces and DOM snapshots from CI
• A demo the agent records in a browser, saved as a run
• Evidence links posted in the pull request, so reviewers see the change working

Test suite health
• Rank your flakiest and slowest tests and spec files
• See which errors break the most tests
• Quarantine, skip or tag tests with rules, and review what they affected

Day-to-day CI work
• Reproduce a bug from a failed run and verify the fix
• Open an issue for a failure in your issue tracker
• Cancel, reset or re-check runs without leaving the chat

For teams whose CI slows them down: flaky tests that block merges, failures nobody has time to dig into, and AI-written pull requests that are hard to trust without seeing the change work. Works with GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Jira, Linear and more. You need a Currents account.
capabilities: Find the root cause of failing tests
Fix flaky tests
Compare pull request runs with main
Find runs by branch, commit or pull request
Follow a test's history across runs
Rank flaky and slow tests and spec files
See which errors break the most tests
Quarantine, skip and tag tests
Review which tests a rule affected
Explore Playwright traces step by step through a trace API
Collect screenshots, videos and traces from CI
Capture real DOM snapshots as evidence
Record a browser demo of a change
Attach high-fidelity proof to pull requests: videos, traces and DOM snapshots of the change working
Create expiring share links to traces
Reproduce bugs and verify fixes
Open issues for test failures
Cancel, reset and delete runs
Cancel GitHub Actions workflows from a run
Integrate with Linear, Jira, Slack and more

positive.description: Ranks the flakiest tests in a project
positive.prompt: Which tests in the currents-e2e project were the flakiest over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the flakiest tests in currents-e2e, each with its flaky rate and number of executions for the last 30 days.

positive.description: Explains why the latest failed run failed
positive.prompt: Why did the latest failed run in currents-e2e fail?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the failed run, the tests that failed and the error message and stack trace for each failure.

positive.description: Collects evidence for a failed test
positive.prompt: Show me the screenshots, video and trace for a failed test in the latest failed currents-e2e run.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns links to the screenshots, video and Playwright trace recorded for the failed test.

positive.prompt: Quarantine the flakiest test in currents-e2e.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a quarantine rule for that test in currents-e2e and reports the rule name and the test it matches.

positive.prompt: Delete the most recent run in mcp-review-project.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, then deletes the most recent run in mcp-review-project and confirms that it was deleted.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: General coding task with no test results involved
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.

publication.release_notes: First release of the Currents plugin: debug failing and flaky tests, collect proof of work for pull requests and manage CI runs from ChatGPT and Codex.
